notes:
Lead: Sarah Kim (Dir Product) - strong product-first org; investigating rerank endpoint to improve search CTR and downstream conversions. Wants an approach that supports offline scoring of candidate sets and online rerank call with p99 < 150ms.

Discovery summary:

- Primary workload: e-commerce-style product search with large candidate pools (50-200 candidates) then offline feature scoring + online rerank.

- Eval approach: will provide 10k annotated queries (eval set) + historical click logs for offline scoring experiments. Wants Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization.

- Deliverables: offline eval report (precision@k, NDCG), latency/cost breakdown, model variant recommendations, and rollout plan to Dedicated.
